title_zh: 雨傘下的第二雙鞋｜車窗裡的陌生人
title_en: The Second Pair of Shoes Under the Umbrella
story_zh: 下班後，暴雨像要把城市沖走。我在末班公車站等車，雨棚太窄，雨水不斷打濕我的肩膀。 一把黑傘無聲地移到身旁，替我擋住了雨。我低頭，白色球鞋旁竟多出一雙濕透的黑皮鞋。 我以為是好心的陌生人，小聲說謝謝。沒有人回答，只有傘面傳來急促的滴答聲。那人始終沒有露臉。 公車終於來了。我匆匆上車，那雙黑皮鞋也跟著踏上階梯。我坐到窗邊，身後的腳步聲卻突然停了。 我鼓起勇氣回頭。後座根本沒有人。可是車窗倒影裡，一個濕淋淋的身影正坐在背後，還撐著黑傘。 我猛地站起來。走道出現第二排濕腳印，從空位一路延伸到我腳邊。所有鞋印都朝向我，沒有回頭的痕跡。 我慢慢看向車窗。那個人站在倒影裡，對著我笑。我突然發現，他沒有腳；黑皮鞋正穿在玻璃裡的我身上。窗上浮出水字：「下一站，換你替我撐傘。」
story_en: After work, rain poured across the city. I waited for the last bus under a narrow shelter. Cold water kept splashing onto my shoulders. A black umbrella silently moved beside me, blocking the rain. I looked down. Next to my white sneakers stood a pair of soaked black leather shoes. I thought a stranger was being kind. I whispered thank you. Nobody answered. Only the rain tapped against the umbrella. I could not see his face. Finally the bus arrived. I climbed aboard. The black shoes followed me up the steps. I sat by the window, and the footsteps suddenly stopped. I turned around. Every seat was empty. But in the window reflection, a dripping figure sat behind me, still holding the black umbrella open. I jumped up. Another trail of wet footprints led down the aisle, from the empty seat to my feet. Every footprint pointed toward me. None pointed back. I stared into the glass. The stranger smiled behind me. Then I saw he had no feet. The black shoes were on my feet inside the reflection. Water spelled out: NEXT STOP. YOUR TURN TO HOLD THE UMBRELLA.
